name: Yazawa Miki
source:
Wife of Maharaja Yazawa. She is a pampered child who calls herself “Miki."

She works as a clerk at a cosplay store. She also likes to wear costumes herself. While wearing a costume, she likes to play the role of the character. Her husband, Maharaja Yazawa, is physically unable to get it up, so she is feeling a bit bored with her young body.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=208021&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
